name: NitroEnclaveVerifier
abi: constructor(address owner, uint64 initialMaxTimeDiff, bytes32[] initializeTrustedCerts, uint64[] initializeTrustedCertExpiries, bytes32 initialRootCert, address initialProofSubmitter, address initialRevoker, uint8 zkCoProcessor, tuple(bytes32 verifierId, bytes32 aggregatorId, address zkVerifier) config, bytes32 verifierProofId)
event AggregatorIdUpdated(uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes32 indexed newId)
event AttestationSubmitted(uint8 result, uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes output)
event BatchAttestationSubmitted(bytes32 verifierId, uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes encodedBatch)
event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed oldOwner, address indexed newOwner)
event VerifierIdUpdated(uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes32 indexed newId, bytes32 newProofId)
event ZKConfigurationUpdated(uint8 zkCoProcessor, tuple(bytes32 verifierId, bytes32 aggregatorId, address zkVerifier) config, bytes32 verifierProofId)
event ZkRouteAdded(uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes4 indexed selector, address verifier)
event ZkRouteWasFrozen(uint8 indexed zkCoProcessor, bytes4 indexed selector)
function addVerifyRoute(uint8 zkCoProcessor, bytes4 selector, address verifier)

function batchVerify(bytes output, uint8 zkCoprocessor, bytes proofBytes) returns (tuple(uint8 result, uint8 trustedCertsPrefixLen, uint64 timestamp, bytes32[] certs, uint64[] certExpiries, bytes userData, bytes nonce, bytes publicKey, tuple(uint64 index, tuple(bytes32 first, bytes16 second) value)[] pcrs, string moduleId)[] results)
function getZkConfig(uint8 zkCoProcessor) view returns (tuple(bytes32 verifierId, bytes32 aggregatorId, address zkVerifier))
function getZkVerifier(uint8 zkCoProcessor, bytes4 selector) view returns (address)
function ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(address pendingOwner) view returns (uint256 result)
function setZkConfiguration(uint8 zkCoProcessor, tuple(bytes32 verifierId, bytes32 aggregatorId, address zkVerifier) config, bytes32 verifierProofId)
function updateVerifierId(uint8 zkCoProcessor, bytes32 newVerifierId, bytes32 newVerifierProofId)

function verify(bytes output, uint8 zkCoprocessor, bytes proofBytes) returns (tuple(uint8 result, uint8 trustedCertsPrefixLen, uint64 timestamp, bytes32[] certs, uint64[] certExpiries, bytes userData, bytes nonce, bytes publicKey, tuple(uint64 index, tuple(bytes32 first, bytes16 second) value)[] pcrs, string moduleId) journal)
function zkConfig(uint8) view returns (bytes32 verifierId, bytes32 aggregatorId, address zkVerifier)
